scope: C2.3/C3.1/C3.2/C6.2 successor live provider boundary; contract and adjudication evidence only; no live provider, no network, no canonical write performed
boundary_terms: LIVE_PROVIDER_GATE_CLOSED: every provider port, credential resolution, provider invocation, readback, cancellation, and provider fallback must remain closed until an explicit live-provider gate is opened.
FIXTURE_IS_NOT_PROVIDER: FixtureProviderEffectGateway, composed no-provider C3 closure, and ReceiptOnlyProviderPort are LOCAL_OFFLINE fixtures and do not constitute production provider wiring.
TYPED_RECEIPT_REQUIRED: every provider attempt must produce a typed receipt with frozen schema and digest; receipt shape and digest semantics are part of the fixture/live equivalence contract.
OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_PRESERVED: unknown outcomes remain typed OUTCOME_UNKNOWN / ProviderOutcomeUnknown; completion is never inferred from an absent receipt and readback must be attempted.
NON_START_PROOF_REQUIRED: an unattempted provider job requires a typed NonStartProof with evidence locator and digest; an unprovable non-start remains NonStartUnprovable and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

AUTHORITY_VALIDATION_REQUIRED: authority profile/binding digest, grant scope, credential decision receipt, lease expiry, and redaction semantics must be validated identically by fixture and live paths.
NO_SECRET_BYTES: fixtures and successor receipts carry no secret bytes; live credential wiring must resolve through redacted refs and ephemeral leases only.
ZERO_PROVIDER_CALLS_UNTIL_GATE: the successor line currently proves provider_calls == 0 and real_provider_calls == 0; any live invocation requires this freeze status to change.
NO_CANDIDATE: candidate creation remains null and is not authorized by this evidence.
NO_NETWORK: deployment binding remains deployment.local-only.no-network.no-provider.no-canonical-write.v1.
NO_PROMOTION_BY_THIS_EVIDENCE: this freeze is a contract/adjudication artifact, not promotion, cutover, authority transfer, external delivery, or canonical write evidence.

fixture_vs_live_equivalence_conditions.rule: Fixture and live provider paths must emit the same typed receipt contract with matching digest semantics (C2.3 ProviderReceipt/ProviderAttemptRef; C6.2 ProviderAttemptReceipt) for equivalent observable provider behavior; no collapsed metadata, no untyped strings, no secret bytes.

When the provider outcome is not terminal, both paths must return typed OUTCOME_UNKNOWN (C2.3 OutcomeUnknownProviderEffect / failure union OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; C6.2 ProviderFailure ProviderOutcomeUnknown) and keep attempt identity; terminal reconciliation requires an authoritative readback.

For an attempt that never started, both paths must produce a typed NonStartProof with evidence locator and digest (C2.3 NonStartProof; C6.2 ProviderReadback NON_START_PROOF); if non-start cannot be proven, both paths must return NonStartUnprovable / no proof and stay OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

Both paths must validate the same authority profile/binding digest (C2.3 mrw.successor.source-library.c2-3.authority.v1; C6.2 authority_requirement_digest), resolve credentials through redacted refs and ephemeral leases with CredentialDecisionReceipt, check grant scope and expiry, and reject MISSING_CREDENTIAL/UNAUTHORIZED identically.

live_gate_prerequisites: Explicit live-provider authority record: a freeze amendment or supervisor/owner authority record that opens the live provider dimension and names each permitted provider and grant scope; the current 02 freeze and amendments 19/21 still exclude live provider.
Per-cell provider adapter review covering transport, credential handling, timeout/retry budget, rate limiting, fallback, cancellation, and recovery semantics.
Fixture-to-live parity evidence for typed receipt, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, non-start proof, and authority validation per cell.
Provider credential policy review: redacted refs only, ephemeral leases, expiry checks, decision receipts, and zero secret bytes in receipts.
Candidate creation gate: candidate stays null until the live gate is opened and reviewed; this evidence does not create a candidate.
Separate promotion/cutover/authority-transfer review remains required after the live gate; opening live provider does not by itself authorize cutover or canonical adoption.

declared_limits: This artifact freezes the live provider dimension as blocked; it does not open any gate, approve any provider, or create a candidate.
Semantic movement completeness requires movement records, runtime authority inventory, and live trace evidence; green tests and exact hashes are not promotion evidence.

Authority exclusions from the 02 freeze remain in force: no production canonical write, no live provider or external network, no external delivery, no cutover or authority transfer, no double claim/double approval write, and no dashboard/broker state as completion authority.
